notes: Seeds are editor-verified primary-source events used to bridge the automatic producer when a first-party feed is delayed or not machine-readable.
A seed may be published only once; the producer deduplicates by article id and source URL.
Seeds expire and never turn generic discovery headlines into verified news.
Seed expiry never overrides the hard 48-hour substantive publication freshness ceiling.
Manual multi-source verified market read-throughs are kept in prepublish and are not mislabelled as primary-source seeds.
Current manual multi-source read-throughs, including current agriculture input-cost coverage, remain on prepublish-news; this primary-source seed file is intentionally empty.
